target: Build the no-store core of the `dopemux-memory-bridge` Claude Code function-hook mod under plugins/dopemux-memory-bridge/: the local JSONL outbox fed by turn.complete, session.compact and session.end, the pending-count status line, and (if the band gate allows) the welcome-back band built from outbox data. No service dependency.
invariants: C01 Shared workspace: other workers may edit this checkout. Edit only your write_surface; preserve others' edits; never revert unrelated work. Work only in the execution worktree .worktrees/memory-bridge-001 on feat/memory-bridge-001 (base 93050d135ffc2592000c1d0edef82b2912935525); verify `git rev-parse --show-toplevel` and the branch before the first write.
C02 You never commit, push, merge, open a PR, sign, tag, change git config or rewrite history. The team lead alone commits (one commit per workstream, explicit pathspec) after re-reading your diff.

C03 ADVISOR FORBIDDEN (budget 0): do not call the `advisor` tool and do not spawn subagents or delegate. advisor_calls is a required return field and must be 0; a nonzero count is a contract breach and the status becomes NEEDS_SUPERVISOR.
C04 Secrets: never read or print .env*, credential files, tokens or keys; never write a secret into a file, test fixture or return. Network use is limited to what this packet names.

C05 Truth buckets: report PASS / FAIL / NOT_RUN / UNKNOWN literally; never collapse NOT_RUN into PASS. Anything live that you did not observe is NOT_RUN. The conport, dope-memory and gpt-researcher MCP connectors were unreachable when this packet was issued: do not invent endpoints, tool names, request fields or ports. Use only interfaces this packet names or that you confirm in source with file:line; otherwise write UNKNOWN.

C06 Return fields: status (exactly one of READY_FOR_AUDIT, BLOCKED, NEEDS_SUPERVISOR, INCOMPLETE), subject, validation (command, exit code, bucket), proof, audit (NOT_RUN: the single final audit is held by the supervisor), blockers (each with the action that clears it), advisor_calls, files_written, observed_model (from a runtime receipt, else UNKNOWN).

C07 Stop and return evidence instead of improvising when: a needed file is outside your write_surface; a contract-sensitive surface (schema, hook registration, MCP manifest) would change; a required fact is UNKNOWN; or validation still fails after one fix attempt for the same cause (no cheap-model repair loop).
C08 Authority order: this packet, then runtime code, then schemas, then tests, then docs. Docs and the opportunity map are not evidence of runtime behaviour.

M01 Authoring contract: the coordinator loads the `plugin-authoring` skill at dispatch and passes you (a) the path of this build's claude-code.d.ts and (b) the reference notes. The declaration checked at issuance is Claude Code 2.1.304, sha256 652e8b9b5ad4d2d7b8936a46c760bf93ab20dc7b72f4334cf3f39dd0b6109385. If the file you receive differs, re-check every event, noun and method you use against it and list each difference in your return. If it was not supplied, STOP and report.

M02 Pattern reference (read-only, `git show feat/pulse-001:plugins/dopemux-pulse/<file>`, else `origin/feat/pulse-001`; if neither resolves, STOP): reuse the Pulse conventions: helpers declared at the top of the file that take `$` and the state object as arguments, every hook body wrapped so no exception surfaces, `session.end` with reason 'clear' keeps running, `Promise.race` against `$.clock.after` for timeouts.

M03 Pulse audit lesson F1 (MEDIUM): `Promise.race` does not cancel `$.http.fetch`, so a hung server can pile up one request per tick. Keep an in-flight flag per endpoint (no new request while a timed-out one may still be pending) and cover it with a test that uses a 'slow' mock.

M04 Hook safety: observing hooks (tool.call, turn.start, turn.complete, session.compact, session.append) call `next(e)` and return its result unchanged: never deny, rewrite, delay or veto. No `prompt.submit` rewriting, no `$.model.*`, no `$.agent.*`, no `$.tool.register`, no `$.session.send`, no slash commands (built-in name collisions are refused: Pulse could not register /focus).

M05 Home: plugins/dopemux-memory-bridge/ with the layout of plugins/dopemux-pulse/ on feat/pulse-001: .claude-plugin/plugin.json, hooks/hooks.json (one module path), hooks/register.tsx, hooks/register.test.ts, README.md. types/index.d.ts exists only if `$.state` is used. Do not write under ~/.claude, do not enable hot reload, do not run `claude plugin install`.

M06 Surfaces: `$.process` is documented CLI-only. Every feature that needs it must degrade (omit its segment, never throw) when it is unavailable, and the outbox plus status line must work without it. Tests cover both cases.

M07 Verification: TDD (show the failing test before the code). Run `claude plugin validate plugins/dopemux-memory-bridge` and `claude plugin test plugins/dopemux-memory-bridge`; type-check with `tsc -p` if the types were laid. Report each as PASS/FAIL/NOT_RUN with the reason. Live proof (a real session loading the mod against running services) is NOT_RUN by design: say what the operator must do to see it.

M08 Privacy: the outbox and anything sent to a store hold only derived fields (goal, relative file paths, marker-detected decisions), never raw prompts, tool output or the assistant's full answer. A deterministic in-mod redactor masks common secret shapes (sk-/ghp_/AKIA tokens, Bearer values, password=/token=/secret= pairs, PEM blocks) and caps every string before it is written or sent.

Gate: dispatch only if the team lead records, from proof/MACRO-DMX-MEMORY-BRIDGE-001/review_bundle/W01_FINDINGS.md, the GATE_TABLE verdicts that this packet's dispatch rule names; UNKNOWN counts as NO_GO. The team lead applies the macro's dispatch table mechanically and may not reinterpret it. A depends_on entry for a workstream the gate did not dispatch is satisfied by that workstream's recorded SKIPPED_BY_GATE state (the dependency exists to serialize writes to one file, not to require the skipped work).

G02 Dispatch rule: W02 runs only if GATE_TABLE.outbox is GO or GO_REDUCED. The band is built only if GATE_TABLE.band is GO or GO_REDUCED; the status-line count is always built with the outbox. Build exactly the reductions GATE_TABLE.reductions names; do not add scope. If outbox is NO_GO or UNKNOWN, STOP with NEEDS_SUPERVISOR.

B01 Hook set: `session.start` (initialise, count pending records, set the status line), `turn.start` (capture the goal: the first 160 characters of the user's text, redacted), `tool.call` observing Edit, Write and NotebookEdit only (collect relative file paths for the turn, then `return next(e)` untouched), `turn.complete` on the main loop only (agentId undefined; append one record), `session.compact` (append a compact record, pass the result through unchanged), `session.end` (final append; reason 'clear' appends but keeps the mod running, as Pulse does), and a `ui.render` hook on { component: 'AbovePrompt' } for the band.

B02 Outbox record, one JSON object per line, schema v:1: { v, id (deterministic: sha256 of session_id + turn_id + kind, truncated), ts, kind ('turn'|'compact'|'end'), session_id, cwd_rel, goal, files_touched (unique relative paths, at most 30), decisions (marker-detected, at most 3), intended_events (the promotable event types this record would emit, from GATE_TABLE.decisions.event_type_sources; empty if none), state ('pending'|'sent'), attempts }. No raw prompt, tool output or answer text. Strings are redacted and capped per M08.

B03 Write model: follow GATE_TABLE.decisions.write_model and outbox_location exactly. `$.fs.write` is whole-content and there is no append or rename: serialise every read-modify-write through one in-module promise chain, keep the file under 1 MiB (over the cap: drop the oldest 'sent' records first, then the oldest 'pending', and count the drops), and never let a write failure surface (status shows it instead).

B04 Decision detection is marker-only and deterministic: a line of `answer` that starts with `Decision:` or `DECISION:` (optionally in bold) yields one decision, at most 3 per turn, 200 characters each. A decision not written with the marker is not captured; the README says so. No model call.

B05 Status line: `$.ui.status` shows the pending count (for example `📮 3 pending`, `📮 clear`), a visible `⚠ outbox write failed` after a failed write, and a `+N dropped` suffix after a cap drop. One status line per plugin; it coexists with the Pulse mod.

B06 Welcome-back band (only if the band gate allows): while the time since the last prompt.submit or turn.complete is at least `idleMinutes` (userConfig, default 30, allowed 5-1440), the AbovePrompt hook shows `Welcome back - you were on <last goal> - last decision <last decision> - <n> uncommitted files`, from the newest outbox records and `git status --porcelain` via `$.process.run` (omitted when $.process is unavailable or fails). It is dismissed by the next prompt.submit. Arm a `$.clock.after` to invalidate the render when the threshold passes; cancel all timers on a real session end. Band text is plain `Text` in `Box`, one line, with no buttons or commands.
B07 No network: this workstream makes no http.fetch call and no store, ConPort or dope-memory call, and no `dopemux` subprocess. Tests assert a single refusal if one is attempted.

B08 Tests (register.test.ts, Pulse harness style): goal/files/decision capture, the redactor, deterministic ids, the 1 MiB cap and drop counting, status strings for pending/clear/failed, per-turn file reset, subagent turns ignored, compact pass-through, 'clear' versus real end, band shown/dismissed/idle threshold, band without $.process, and a write failure that does not surface.
